premises: THREE LANES ARE LIVE ON THIS CLI. Backward compatibility is a requirement: a change that breaks their next release turns one blocked card into three.

Your own DOUBLE-CLOSE-AUDIT is the spec. Split release into --as close (requires a contract-complete close artifact), --as abandon (requires a real reason, logged ABANDONED, must stay possible), --as steal --force (logged STEAL). Kill the --reason default.

When --as is omitted, infer close IF AND ONLY IF the close artifact exists and carries leave_behind; otherwise refuse and print both forms. That keeps the happy path working and makes release-without-close loud.

A closed card accepts an ADDENDUM BESIDE the close, never over it. The second artifact in the incident was the BETTER one - the first close said Travis and Williamson timed out and they finished 16 seconds later. Keep both, make duplication visible.
status printing CARD_CLOSED must print the addendum command. The lane that overwrote the close had just been told the card was closed and had no cheaper option offered.
note: The queue stays ADVISORY. You are not closing the bypass - the L3 fleet ruling forbids turning it into a dispatcher. You are making the sanctioned path the easier one at the moment of refusal.
